steps.title: Open the home page
steps.narration: Let's start on Trendora's home page — the small status pill at the top of every page is how the app tells you, at a glance, whether today's board can be trusted.
steps.point_out: The top-bar pill reads 'Ready' in green, with a thin green banner underneath confirming 'GO — today's board is current' — even right after a fresh boot or a backend restart, the app never leaves you guessing about its own health.

steps.title: Open the Data Manager
steps.narration: The Data Manager page is where the dataset's coverage lives, and where new historical days get pulled in.
steps.point_out: The Dataset coverage panel shows real numbers for price history, universe size, and trading days — all computed and stored ahead of time, never recalculated on the spot while you wait.

steps.title: Enter a backfill start date
steps.narration: Typing a start date into the backfill form begins a request to fill in a specific day's data.

steps.title: Enter a backfill end date
steps.narration: The end date completes the range — here it's the very same single day.

steps.title: Start the backfill job
steps.narration: Clicking Start submits the request. Because this day was already pulled in earlier, Trendora is upfront about it instead of pretending something new happened.
steps.point_out: The job status badge reads 'no new snapshots' in a neutral grey — a distinct, honest outcome, never dressed up as a fresh success.

steps.title: Browse the Scanner Runs history
steps.narration: Every day the scanner has run lives here as a dated, unchanging snapshot.
steps.point_out: The row for May 15, 2026 shows its market regime and stock counts immediately — no loading skeleton, no refresh needed.

steps.title: Open a single day's scan
steps.narration: Clicking into a date opens the exact view the scanner produced that day.
steps.point_out: The Scanner Run page reproduces the same regime and counts from the table, with a full leaderboard below it — pulled straight from storage, never recomputed live.

steps.title: Back to the Data Manager
steps.narration: Back on the Data Manager page to see how it handles a much larger date range.

steps.title: Enter a much wider date range
steps.narration: Setting the start date over a year back sets up a much bigger backfill request.

steps.title: Enter the range's end date
steps.narration: The end date extends the span past 400 days — well beyond what a size-capped system would allow.

steps.title: Start the large backfill
steps.narration: Trendora accepts the whole range at once — no 'range too large' rejection — and works through it in visible chunks, so you can watch real progress even on a very large job.
steps.point_out: The Job progress panel shows a chunk counter and an advancing progress bar, proving the big request was accepted and is actively running.
